name: DeckForge MCP
tagline: Turn meeting notes, memos, and business numbers into ready-to-present, editable slide decks.
description: DeckForge helps business leaders, chiefs of staff, finance teams, and consultants turn rough notes or quarterly numbers into clear, well-structured 6-slide presentations. Preview every slide, edit headlines and talking points in plain English, and download a fully editable PowerPoint (.pptx) file or 1-page Meeting Read-Ahead Brief.

pricing.pro_tier: $24/month for unlimited editable PowerPoint (.pptx) & online slide decks

privacy_and_security.data_retention: Your notes and numbers are processed in-memory to build your slides and are never stored or used to train AI models.
privacy_and_security.encryption: Encrypted in transit with secure sign-in protection.

verification_test_prompts: Turn our Q3 business update (Revenue $18.4M +142% YoY, Net Retention 124%, Gross Margin 81%) into a 6-slide Boardroom Navy presentation and give me a downloadable PowerPoint file.
Change Slide 2 to a Quarterly Bar Chart layout and tighten the headline and speaker talking points.
